title: Builds 0.5.0.1 through 0.5.0.4.1: keybind fix, exploit fixes, new items, anti-cheat, player menu unification
body:
## Summary

- **0.5.0.1**: Fix jumping by changing vehicle window keybind to Alt+W
- **0.5.0.2**: Fix inventory exploit on mode re-entry, fix disconnect leaving players in broken lobby, improve connection timeout UX
- **0.5.0.3**: Replace binoculars with Biomonitor Bracelet (Shift+U scan), replace fortified rations with WireNet (medical auto-heal), add bracelet/medical equipment slots
- **0.5.0.4**: Fix ping timeout (20s), improve disconnect detection (8s heartbeat), port walk/fire time validation to server, unify player menus across lobby and game
- **0.5.0.4.1**: Fix Free for All giving all players the name "for" due to spaces in map name breaking spawn_player parsing

Stable and ready to merge.
